subject: Pre-award: PackWave risk packet & PO orchestration
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@packwave.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-award: PackWave risk packet & PO orchestration

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement is ready to move toward PO issuance but we have a couple of pre-award items to close first:

1) Certificate of Insurance that names Redwood Inference as Additional Insured (GL + Auto, min limits attached in the intake form).
2) Completed supplier intake form (banking + remit instructions) so Accounts Payable can queue the PO.
3) W-9 or local tax form for PackWave Inc.

If you can send the COI and W-9 today we should be able to provision a conditional PO by end of week; final PO will release after the COI endorsement is confirmed.

I've attached the intake form (PDF) and pasted the short acceptance criteria below. Please loop Elena (ops) if that's easier for document uploads.

Acceptance checklist (minimum):
- COI listing: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Policy period active through contract start date
- Limits: $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate (Cyber screen may vary)

Next steps: Once we receive the COI + W-9 + intake form, AP (Logan) will create a conditional PO and notify you of the PO number and expected invoice flow.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: supplier_intake_form.pdf (form), coi-requirements.docx (guidance)
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@packwave.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Moreno <elena@packwave.io>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pre-award: PackWave risk packet & PO orchestration

Neha —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Attached are the COI and our W-9; Elena is copied and will handle any follow-ups. A quick note on the COI: our carrier provided the COI but they do not automatically include the endorsement language for Additional Insured on the COI itself. We can request an endorsement (it takes 48–72 hours) or provide a separate endorsement form if that helps expedite.

Files attached: packwave_coi_2026-07-27.pdf, packwave_w9_2026-07-27.pdf

If a conditional PO is needed immediately for SOW kickoff, we are fine with that as long as the final PO is contingent on the endorsement arriving.

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Partnerships
PackWave Inc.

--
PackWave note: for endorsement routing, contact brokery@packwave.io
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@packwave.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-award: PackWave risk packet & PO orchestration

Folks —

I reviewed the COI and W-9. COI looks standard but we do need the Additional Insured endorsement copy (noted in procurement guidance). To keep timeline, I'll create a PO in our system and mark it as CONDITIONAL (PO-2026-3287). Conditional PO will allow PackWave to start onboarding with the SOW accepted; final invoice payment will require a validated endorsement.

Marissa from Legal, I copied you to track the endorsement language — if there are any deviations from the template please flag asap.

Logistics for invoices: please send invoices to accounts-payable@packwave.io and cc ap@redwood.com with the PO number on the invoice header. AP will hold final payment until endorsement is uploaded to the intake drive link below.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Accounts Payable Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)

Related link: https://drive.google.com/packwave_onboarding_packet
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@packwave.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-award: PackWave risk packet & PO orchestration

Thanks team —

I reviewed the COI and endorsement request. Our standard endorsement language is fine; PackWave's carrier needs to provide either: (a) an endorsement form explicitly naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Additional Insured, or (b) an email from the broker with the full endorsement text. Once we have that, Legal will sign off and AP can move the PO from CONDITIONAL -> ACTIVE and release the first invoice payment.

Sanjay — if you can escalate to the broker and provide ETA, that will help us finalize the schedule. For transparency I've added a short checklist below for your broker:
- Endorsement wording matching Redwood standard (I can paste template on request)
- Policy number and effective dates matching COI
- Broker contact name and phone

I'll loop back once endorsement is received.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs referenced in the thread: packwave_coi_2026-07-27.pdf, packwave_w9_2026-07-27.pdf, supplier_intake_form_filled.pdf
